people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Our Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.
translations.bsb: Our Redeemer—the LORD of Hosts is His name— is the Holy One of Israel.
translations.kjv: As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
translations.asv: Our Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
